answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 10 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 820 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The cipher of the design is public, the nectar of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the inlet of honest work is what finally pays.
